{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''Guudrian language''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Guudrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="DSC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> native to the [[Guudria system/Legends|Guudria system]].<ref name="Planetnamia">{{JCFCite|url=posts/27848315|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2007-12-11|time=7:59 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170916153037/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-43|quote=I wouldn't get your hopes up re alien homeworlds, beyond simple stuff like the Planetnamian species getting a Planetnamia on the map or things Dan and I can account for with a relatively quick reference.|archivefile=File:JasonFry-JCFAtlasHomeworlds.png}} [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated his intention to create homeworlds for numerous species based on context implied from their names. Guudria appears to be one such case.</ref>

{{Language-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' indicates that the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Krudar]] has to translate for [[Boom]], a Guudrian whom no one else can understand. The [[roleplaying game]] materials never give the name of the language Boom is speaking, however.<ref name="DSC" />
